title: Objects [Nested & Modifying]
description:
## Modifying Objects
You can change properties after creation:
```ts
const video = { title: "Cat", views: 100 };
video.views = 200;
video.views += 50;
video["title"] = "Dog";
```

Wait - `const` but we can modify it? `const` means you can't reassign the variable, but you CAN change what's inside the object.

```ts
const video = { title: "Cat" };
video.title = "Dog";          // fine
video = { title: "Bird" };     // ERROR! can't reassign
```

## Nested Objects
Objects can contain other objects:
```ts
const channel = {
    name: "MeTube Gaming",
    stats: {
        subscribers: 50000,
        totalViews: 1000000
    }
};
console.log(channel.stats.subscribers);  // 50000
console.log(channel["stats"]["totalViews"]); // 1000000
```
